brief:
Beekeepers in Gaza have resumed beekeeping operations after a sustained pause, according to the Ma'an news agency. The revival marks a return to agricultural practices disrupted by the territory's prolonged conflict and humanitarian crisis.

Honeybees and their products hold economic and nutritional significance for Gaza's population. The resumption of beekeeping reflects efforts by local farmers to restore livelihoods and food production amid ongoing challenges.
title: Beekeepers revive hives across Gaza
